chapter: Chicago pioneers, community and New Orleans brotherhood
title: No regrets staying in Chicago; the 50th anniversary
summary: Saunders has no regret not joining big bands; community support is selling tickets for his fiftieth anniversary.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Well, see, that was the way my life was all the way through. And this is why it's been such a pleasure. Somebody asked me about Chicago, I says, did I regret it, not going with the different big bands and things like that. I said, no, I don't regret it. I said, I've lived a beautiful life right here in Chicago, people have been so

good to me. Now we're getting ready to do this 50th anniversary and you would be surprised, you would really be surprised at the support I get from people. They go out and sell (inaudible), and they remember you and they come. One just left -- sell 50 tickets for you.
-- behind you. There's all that community appreciation.
